Elara Dawn — Album 3.5: House of Miracles

Is This the Beginning or The End

"Is this the beginning"

[Intro — stillness, faint organ, everything frozen]

No one moves.

Not her. Not me.

And yet— everything is waiting.

…

Is this the beginning…

…

or the end?

[Verse 1 — Elara arrives, grounded, observing]

I walked through what was left of it Ash and fractured stone Every place that fell behind me

Led me here alone

The walls are barely holding The fire barely breathes But something in this silence

Still refuses just to leave

And you stand there in the ruin Like it never touched your name

Like everything that ended

Was exactly what you claimed

[Pre-Chorus — she studies Pandora, something feels off]

I should feel something break in me Standing face to face

But something here is different

Something I can’t place

[Chorus — question reframed through Elara]

Is this the beginning Or the end of what you’ve done Is this the beginning

Or the last of everyone

You took the world down quietly You let it disappear

But something still remains

…

Because I’m still here

[Verse 2 — recognition without understanding]

You look like every story They were too afraid to name Like something that was always there

Before it had a face

And standing here before you There’s something pulling through

Not fear— not surrender—

…

something almost like I knew

But I don’t remember how And I don’t know what it means

Only that I’m standing

Where no one else has been

[Pre-Chorus 2 — tension rising inward]

You waited for me to come here You built this final place

But you’re the first thing I have seen

That I cannot replace

[Chorus — stronger, more certain]

Is this the beginning Of something you can’t control Is this the ending

Of everything you stole

You say the world belongs to you You say it’s all complete

But something still stands in front of you

…

And that is me

[Bridge — time suspended, realization without clarity]

The wind has stopped its movement The sky forgot to fall The dead don’t speak around us

There’s no one left to call

And yet this space between us Feels heavier than war

Like something here existed

…

long before

(quiet)

I don’t know what I am to you

I don’t know what you see

But something in this moment says

You were not meant to finish me

[Final Chorus — calm, resolved, not victory]

Is this the beginning Or the end we cannot name Is this the beginning

Or the break inside your frame

You gathered every piece of this You shaped it to your design

But something you could never take

…

was mine

Is this the beginning …or the end

[Outro — cliffhanger, command hanging in the air]

You wanted me to come here.

…

I did.

Now we stand.

And everything is waiting.

(whispered, almost to herself)

If I say the word…

…they will follow.

(Pause)

If I don’t…

…this ends differently.

(Long silence)

Do I hold the line…

…

or do I give the order?

(Silence stretches)

I’m still here.
